# Gramlot examples 0.3.8 — Demonstrate slider correction of fractional sizes

The nested layout lesson l05 explains how step=1 corrects fractional splitter sizes through the shared Data binding. Its Inspector exercise sets 176.73 and shows the value converge to 177, with the panel and slider following it.

The browser regression injects fractional values into all seven size paths and verifies live drag writeback before release, integer Data and matching panel geometry. Python and JavaScript use the same behavior. Requires core 0.3.5 or later; dependencies remain uncapped.
